prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile app concept for Pino, an operational youth-sports tryout tool. Single full-bleed portrait app UI screenshot, 1024x1536 composition, no device frame, no scene or perspective.
Primary request: PLAYER THREADS concept. A selected-player workspace inspired by the clarity of team messaging, emphasizing shared coach observations and a current decision. Design the actual app surface, never a concept poster.
Structure from top to bottom:
1. Compact dark teal navigation header: wordmark "Pino" on left. Context below or alongside: "Northside FC" and "Spring 2027 tryout". Small clearly visible "Sample data" badge. Header should be efficient, leaving room for task content.
2. Thin practical progress/context row reading "48 players" and "19 awaiting decision", understated tiny progress indicator allowed.
3. Clear left-arrow "Back to roster" affordance.
4. Prominent selected-player identity region: "Avery Morgan"; supporting "Graduation year 2031"; clear pale-teal status "Awaiting decision". Keep the player and status visually anchored at the top of task content.
5. Center is "Shared notes", with a precise vertical timeline rule and two observation entries. Small circular initials are optional, no portrait photos. First author "Coach Sam", text verbatim: "Checks shoulder before receiving; confident turning into space." Second author "Coach Lee", text verbatim: "Looked comfortable with either foot in the small-sided game." Use readable line lengths, high contrast, and generous breathing room. Notes feel like team observations, not chat bubbles.
6. A practical visible note composer with label "Add a shared note", empty multi-line field with placeholder "What did you notice?", clear filled teal button "Save note". Do not invent any entered draft, timestamp, or additional observation.
7. Separate strong secondary outlined action "Record decision". A short quiet explanatory line may read "Placed, withdrawn, or not selected." Keep action comfortably tappable. Can add a tiny note "Decisions can be revised." only if composition has room.
Visual system: pale daylight background #F8FAFC, dark teal #152E38 navigation and text, saturated calm teal #006B63 actions, pale teal #DAE9E7 status. Crisp white functional surfaces, precise light-gray timeline rules and separators, minimal small-radius corners, confident workhorse sans typography like a modern field operations app. Deliberate hierarchy, compact chrome, readable mobile body text, comfortable large controls, aligned margins. Selected player and shared notes are the focal point. Polished, credible, usable software screenshot.
All displayed facts are fictional sample data. Product works on connected phones/tablets during tryouts, computers afterward. Coaches and administrators can finalize and revise outcomes. One current team per season; do not imply multiple placements or approvals.
Avoid: scores, rankings, stars, invented metrics, private notes, offline indicators, syncing badges, approval workflow, parents or contact details, pitch/tactics illustration, chat reactions, typing/presence indicators, read receipts, gradients, glass effects, oversized marketing titles, stock photography, decorative blobs, bottom device home indicator, phone status bar, physical notebook styling. No extra dashboard cards, no sidebar. Do not overcrowd.
